description: This file contains utility functions for determining if a network host address is a loopback or private LAN address, including checks for Android emulator environments and parsing IPv4/IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: isLoopbackGatewayHost
methods.description: Checks if a given host string is a loopback address (IPv4 or IPv6) or localhost, considering emulator bridge aliases.

methods.name: isPrivateLanGatewayHost
methods.description: Determines if a host string is a private LAN address, including local network ranges and link-local addresses.
